title: Fake provider settings
description: Every behavior of the dummy server, for supervisor and walking skeleton tests.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.description: Text the server returns from GET /config.

label.title: Label
label.description: Free text passed as --label, to prove arguments never go through a shell.

readyDelayMs.title: Ready delay (ms)
readyDelayMs.description: How long GET /ready answers 503 after start; 0 is ready at once.

crashAfterMs.title: Crash after (ms)
crashAfterMs.description: Exit with the crash exit code after this long; 0 never crashes.

logLinesPerSecond.title: Log lines per second
logLinesPerSecond.description: Log lines written to stdout and stderr in turn; 0 writes none.

initDelayMs.title: Init delay (ms)
initDelayMs.description: How long init waits after reading the token and before touching the data folder; 0 does not wait.

authToken.title: Auth token
authToken.description: Written into the sensitive config and passed to init on stdin.
